extracted.name: Gambas Al Ajillo
ingredient_lines: 4-5 dried hot chili peppers or 1 tsp crushed red pepper flakes
some toasted thick crusty bread to soak up all the yummy garlic flavor
instruction_lines: Clean, peel and divined your shrimp. Then marinate with lemon, salt and pepper.
Put butter in pan and add a pinch of olive oil. Add garlic, paprika, tomato paste and oyster sauce.
Once your sauce is ready, add shrimp. Put the temperature a bit higher. Once the shrimp is fully cooked top with chilli flakes, toasted garlic and parsley. Serve with toasted crusty bread and enjoy!
